instruction: Disable the automatic lock screen when the computer is suspended.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent successfully navigated Settings → Privacy → Screen, enabled Automatic Screen Lock toggle, and set Blank Screen Delay to 5 minutes in 9 turns.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can navigate GNOME Settings panels, toggle switches on/off, use dropdown menus, understand privacy/screen lock settings.
metadata.task_rationale: Related task on the same Privacy → Screen panel. Requires toggling off 'Lock Screen on Suspend' which was visible in the trajectory screenshots as an enabled toggle.
metadata.explanation: Task requires disabling lock-on-suspend via Privacy → Screen settings. Evaluator checks gsettings ubuntu-lock-on-suspend is false.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly uses vm_command_line to check 'gsettings get org.gnome.desktop.screensaver ubuntu-lock-on-suspend', which is the correct Ubuntu gsettings key for lock-on-suspend behavior.
Metric exact_match correctly receives rules dict {'expected': 'false\n'} and compares result via rules['expected'], matching the framework's rule-type data flow.
Expected value 'false\n' correctly matches gsettings output when lock-on-suspend is disabled.
Full instruction coverage: the single requirement (disable lock screen on suspend) is fully verified by the evaluator.
Config setup sets a different key (lock-enabled) as a precondition, which does not conflict with the evaluator's check on ubuntu-lock-on-suspend.
